mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE del_flag = 0 AND (id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors))

SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN sys_role_dept rd ON d.id = rd.dept_id WHERE rd.role_id = #{roleId} AND d.del_flag = 0 AND d.status = 1 ORDER BY d.order_num
